name: drone_audio_v3
task: Is there a drone sound in this 1 s of audio? Output: probability 0..1.

input.name: logmel
input.how_to_make_it: mono audio at sr Hz, 1 s window; STFT with n_fft, hop, periodic Hann window, centred (reflect pad); power spectrum; multiply by the mel filterbank (in the JSON, 'mel_fb'); natural log of (mel + log_eps); then (x - norm_mean) / norm_std

output.name: prob
output.decision: a clip is 'drone' if any 1 s window (0.5 s hop) reaches the threshold
